desc:
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game to support future updates!

Literally SPRUNKI 🎵 is a fan-made Roblox experience inspired by Sprunki, bringing its unique music-mixing style to Roblox. Create your own mixes and enjoy the game on PC, mobile, and console.

Feel free to share your creations with friends or on social media!
